# Duncastle Air Cargo — evening journals

booking-api and dispatch-relay write separate journals for the same night. Each line quotes the shipment it belongs to (shipment=<reference>); stage= echoes the writing system. A line belongs to the shipment named in it. Banner lines open with === and are not events.
